builds.howItPlays: Play a cheap Equipment most turns so Azir can make a 2 Might Sand Soldier token, which picks up one of your Equipment for less as it arrives, and add more soldiers with Guards! and Arise!. When Azir, Sovereign attacks he pulls every token you have to his battlefield, while spells you set face down wait to clear blockers on the opponent's turn.
builds.whyYou: You like building an army a piece at a time, a sword here and a soldier there, until one turn the whole lot marches in together. You keep a few answers face down for the opponent's turn, so they never quite know what attacking into your soldiers will cost them. If a board that grows every turn and one planned big swing sound fun, Azir suits you.
builds.ratingNotes: Scored decks: Barcelona RQ #3 (MICE Squirtle) https://piltoverarchive.com/decks/view/eda76bcc-e64e-418d-a236-cec043c7056f 4.5/6/7/3.5; Azir Baltimore (mattzack) https://piltoverarchive.com/decks/view/c1824241-3193-475f-b0ad-00afd4d3bb50 4.5/6/7/3.5; PG Yvuri - Azir Sand Castle https://piltoverarchive.com/decks/view/c60ab795-7ff0-465b-973c-5787601ff321 4.5/6/7/3.5. Mean Midrange 4.5/6/7/3.5 (tools.ts style; labels Midrange x3). Adjustments on all three: pace +1 (Legend makes a 2 Might Sand Soldier every turn you play an Equipment, 16 to 17 Equipment per list); stance +1 (Legend adds a body most turns); complexity +1 (Legend needs an Equipment played first each turn, and Weaponmaster soldiers pick up gear as they enter). Deciding cards: Pace, only 2 to 3 unit cards while the Legend, Guards! (3, Hidden) and Arise! (6+1 power) make the real bodies, so formula Pace ran 3.5 to 4 against judged 5.5 (Baltimore gap is exactly 2; tags re-read and correct, the +1 adjustment is the most the gap can take). Stance, 15 to 16.5 pressure (Guards!, Arise!, Azir, Sovereign, Eye of the Herald) against 11 to 13 answers (Hidden Blade, Back Off, Defy, Doran's Shield tagged counter as Tank gear, Kennen). Complexity, 18 to 20 reactive cards plus setup gear (Soul Sword, Hand Hammer, Eye of the Herald) and Azir, Sovereign's token pull. Variance, no luck or swing cards and 75 to 82 percent of the list run as 3-ofs. Legend ability: Your Sand Soldiers have Weaponmaster; pay 1 and exhaust: play a 2 Might Sand Soldier token to base, only if you've played an Equipment this turn. Also played: Protect the Emperor Azir (Azir, Ascendant with Guardian Angel, Scuttle Crab and Stellacorn Herder protecting a few units, no Arise!), Midrange 4.5/4.5/7/3.5 over https://piltoverarchive.com/decks/view/c4e7be05-18fd-43fc-961f-9f8ca660579d (Najlaron VEN v1.05, 4.5/5/7.5/4), https://piltoverarchive.com/decks/view/1b8a0ecc-b613-4f2f-9be1-25589f4ec077 (Kylen, 131 likes and a video, 5/4.5/7/3.5; scorer suggested Tempo on 14 reactive and Pace 5, judged Midrange because its reactions protect a small board rather than back cheap attackers), https://piltoverarchive.com/decks/view/edf140be-d7e1-4dbd-90e3-d703fd4c80cd (putra_mahkota, 4/4.5/7/3.5); folded in because it shares the label and sits under 2 from this Build on every Axis. Confidence: high.
